data.title: Bitcoin Investors Who Bought Last Year's Rally Are Selling As Price Nears Their Break-Even, Glassnode Says
data.description: As Bitcoin struggled to break past $85,000 on Saturday, investors who bought into the apex cryptocurrency during last year's rally were selling more coins per day than at any other point this year, according to on-chain analytics firm Glassnode.On X, Glassnode grouped holders by when they bought an…
